description: Recipe for the offline synthetic demo of scrna-embedding-audit. generate_demo_adata() reads this file; the embeddings are derived from the simulated counts, not drawn from the labels.

embeddings.X_corrected: PCA of the log-normalised matrix after centring each gene within each batch
embeddings.X_batchy: PCA of the globally centred log-normalised matrix with the batch genes weighted x5
embeddings.X_overcorrected: PCA after per-batch centring with every marker gene removed
